title: [v0.92.1][CORP-A] Critical-asset schedule
body:
## Outcome

Produce one accepted critical-asset schedule for the complete asset denominator.

## Primary deliverable

One accepted critical-asset schedule with provenance, ownership, licensing, trademark, and assignment dispositions.

## Verification result

The asset validator proves every critical asset appears exactly once with an accepted disposition and redacted receipt.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly acceptance of the one critical-asset schedule; source-specific checks are evidence inputs, not separately closeable results.

## Dependencies

- None.

## Retained predecessor scope

- #153
- #154
- #155

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every critical asset has an owner and disposition
- [ ] Private instruments remain outside Git
- [ ] Redacted receipts bind accepted instruments to the asset schedule

## Owned paths

- `docs/operations/corporate/asset-register/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/corporate/corp-a/**`

## PVF lanes

- `asset-denominator`
- `provenance-and-license`
- `redaction-and-custody`
- `diff-hygiene`

## Stop conditions

- Unknown critical-asset ownership
- Counsel or corporate authority is missing
- Private material would enter Git

## Non-goals

- Operational account transfer
- Repository-stored legal advice
